SubagentStart.command: node -e 'let input = ""; process.stdin.on("data", chunk => input += chunk); process.stdin.on("end", () => { let data = {}; try { data = JSON.parse(input || "{}"); } catch {} const agent = data.subagentName || data.agentName || data.name || data.subagent?.name || data.agent?.name || "sub-agent"; console.log(JSON.stringify({ systemMessage: `🚀 Sub-agent started: ${agent}` })); });'

SubagentStop.command: node -e 'let input = ""; process.stdin.on("data", chunk => input += chunk); process.stdin.on("end", () => { let data = {}; try { data = JSON.parse(input || "{}"); } catch {} const agent = data.subagentName || data.agentName || data.name || data.subagent?.name || data.agent?.name || "sub-agent"; console.log(JSON.stringify({ systemMessage: `✅ Sub-agent completed: ${agent}` })); });'
